gui.middleworld.hint: Press %s to return to your inventory
message.middleworld.villager_refuses: The villager refuses to speak with you.
effect.middleworld.villagers.hostile: Iron Golems attack you on sight and villagers refuse to trade with you.
effect.middleworld.villagers.unfriendly: Villagers charge you higher prices. It only gets worse from here.
effect.middleworld.villagers.neutral: Villagers treat you like any stranger. Normal prices.
effect.middleworld.villagers.honored: Good discounts from villagers. You are trusted in every village.
effect.middleworld.villagers.allied: The best discounts from villagers. The village treats you like family.
effect.middleworld.pillagers.hostile: Pillagers despise you and show no mercy.
effect.middleworld.pillagers.unfriendly: Pillagers attack you on sight and see you as a rival.
effect.middleworld.pillagers.neutral: Pillagers attack you on sight, as they would any outsider.
effect.middleworld.pillagers.friendly: Pillagers leave you alone unless you attack them. Pillager trading arrives in a later update.
effect.middleworld.pillagers.honored: Pillagers ignore you, even during raids. More raider perks arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.pillagers.allied: Pillagers treat you as one of their own. Joining raids arrives in a later update.
effect.middleworld.goblins.hostile: Goblins hunt you the moment they see you.
effect.middleworld.goblins.neutral: Goblins attack you on sight, like most monsters.
effect.middleworld.goblins.friendly: Goblins stay calm around you unless provoked. Goblin trading arrives in a later update.
effect.middleworld.goblins.honored: Goblins ignore you completely. Deeper goblin perks arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.goblins.allied: Goblins treat you as one of their own. Goblin quests arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.elves.hostile: Elves attack you on sight and hunt you through the forest.
effect.middleworld.elves.neutral: Elves watch you warily but leave you alone unless provoked.

effect.middleworld.elves.honored: Elven gifts and quests arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.elves.allied: Elves treat you as kin. Fighting beside you arrives in a later update.
effect.middleworld.dwarves.hostile: Dwarves attack you on sight and hunt you through the mountains.
effect.middleworld.dwarves.neutral: Dwarves watch you warily but leave you alone unless provoked.
effect.middleworld.dwarves.friendly: Dwarves welcome you. Dwarf trading and hall access arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.dwarves.honored: Dwarven gifts and quests arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.dwarves.allied: Dwarves treat you as kin. Fighting beside you arrives in a later update.
effect.middleworld.piglins.hostile: Piglins are hostile toward you. Hunting parties arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.piglins.unfriendly: Piglins distrust you. They behave as they do in vanilla.
effect.middleworld.piglins.neutral: Piglins behave as they do in vanilla.
effect.middleworld.piglins.friendly: Piglins try to stay calm around you unless provoked. Better barter offers arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.piglins.honored: Piglins leave you alone. Expanded barter offers arrive in a later update.
effect.middleworld.piglins.allied: Piglins treat you as a friend. Piglin quests arrive in a later update.
